method: Boot the real first-party DSH Host with the test-owned deterministic LOCAL adapter and inspect the persisted session event vocabulary plus the product own telemetry.

observedResults.generationOccurred: yes — a local, test-owned deterministic adapter produced the turn (the session records turn/start, step/start, request/header, assistant/attempt, step/end, turn/end)

measuredAdapterConstraint: MEASURED DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 BEHAVIOUR: adding an OPTIONAL adapter method named providerRetryPolicy caused the cordis plugin to FAIL ACTIVATION (1 entry did not activate); the agent then never reached a model turn and the session recorded no user/message. With the method absent the gate PASSes. The E0 adapter therefore declares no retry policy, matching the shape the shipped P2-D2 gate proved activatable.
whyNoneOfThisEstablishesStochasticUtilit: The adapter is deterministic: it answers every call with the SAME fixed tool call, so it cannot produce the run-to-run variation a utility assay requires.
No external provider was contacted and no paid model was called, so no real model behaviour was observed.
